title: fix(service-analytics)!: the draft preview refuses one column asked raw beside its own time bucket, as the live faces do
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XB1hsVtuncZ5F5C4zpiftHC)_

Fixes #28765

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the draft preview (`queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true`) now refuses `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 a selection that asks one column for two values under one name (a dimension `X` beside a `timeDimensions` entry `OBJECT.X` with a granularity, or two buckets of one column), with the message, `path`, `param`, `object` and `fields` the native and ObjectQL strategies already answer; it served both columns. Nothing is widened: no export, answer member, error code or status is added, and the code was already on the wire.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` says the draft preview serves a column raw beside its own bucket.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing on the `queryDataset` draft preview (`@objectstack/service-analytics`).

Card thread: `session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：草稿预览遇到「同一列既要原值又要它的时间桶」（例如维度 `closed_at` 加上按月分桶的 `对象名.closed_at`），或同一列的两个时间桶时，改为 400 `INVALID_QUERY` 拒绝，消息、`path` 等字段与原生 SQL、ObjectQL 两面逐字一致。之前预览照样给出两列，而发布后线上会拒绝。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28765（p3），是 PR #28762 开发时实测到的同族缺口：作者在草稿里看到一张表，发布后同一个查询却 400。
- **风险与回滚**：这是预览面的收窄，需要合约评审（席位跑）。只拒绝线上本来就拒绝的写法；不同列的时间桶、维度本身也作为时间维度（一个桶）、同列两个维度（#28744）照样服务，都有测试钉住。线上两面行为不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：新文件 `packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-group-column-door.ts`；`strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` 抽出的 `groupByOf`；`analytics-service.ts` 预览闸门列表末尾的调用。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts`，预期 27 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

- **`strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`.** The direct path's `groupBy` build moves, unchanged, into a public `groupByOf(query, cube)`, which `execute` calls; the key type is exported as `AggregateGroupKey` (the package root does not export this module). No behaviour change on the live faces.
- **`preview-group-column-door.ts` (new).** `assertPreviewGroupColumnsDistinct(object, groupBy)` refuses keys that project one column twice, `INVALID_QUERY` / 400, with the engine's message, `path` (`groupBy.N` / `groupBy.N.field`), `param: 'groupBy'`, `object` and `fields`, plus `httpStatus`.
- **Not a shared helper, and why.** The live refusal is `@objectstack/objectql`'s `assertAggregatedColumnsAreDistinct` (`aggregate-query-shape-door.ts`). `@objectstack/objectql` is a dev dependency of `service-analytics`, never a runtime one, and its root does not export the door, so the preview cannot call it without a new runtime dependency or a `packages/objectql` export. The order allows a copy in that case: only the `groupBy` half is copied (the strategy's keys carry no `alias`), and the test compares the preview's refusal with both live faces field by field, message included, so a change to the engine's wording reds it (ablation C2).
- **`analytics-service.ts`.** The preview gate list asks the door last, after `assertPreviewJoinsNothing`, over `this.objectqlStrategy.groupByOf(q, cube)`: the built-in ObjectQL strategy is now also held by name, the same instance in the strategy chain. So the positions the preview names are the engine's by construction.
- Tests: four cases added to `src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts` (now 27, real SQLite).
- Changeset `.changeset/28765-preview-refuses-column-raw-beside-bucket.md`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch, with the adr-0087 not-required marker.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `850eab2a` (real SQLite, every face), dataset over a deal object (`region`, `closed_at` datetime) with dimensions `region`, `closed_at` (date):

| selection | native | ObjectQL | preview before | preview after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| dims `closed_at` + td `OBJECT.closed_at` month | `INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.1.field` … `groupBy.0` | same | served raw instants + months | same refusal as live |
| dims `region`, `closed_at` + td `OBJECT.closed_at` month | `INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.2.field` … `groupBy.1` | same | served | same refusal as live |
| td `closed_at` month + td `OBJECT.closed_at` year | `INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.1.field` … `groupBy.0.field` | same | served | same refusal as live |
| dims `region` + td `closed_at` month | served | served | served | served (unchanged) |
| dims `closed_at` + td `closed_at` month | one bucket | one bucket | one bucket | one bucket (unchanged) |

## Tests

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablations</summary>

- Red on base: `analytics-service.ts` and `objectql-strategy.ts` restored to `850eab2a` and the new door removed, tests at HEAD `722fbe7c`: `Tests 3 failed | 24 passed (27)`; the three refusal cases fail on the preview leg. Restored, `git status` clean.
- Green at `722fbe7c`: `27 passed (27)`.
- Ablations at `3b296a59` (pre-rebase; the rebase onto `8afaf12d` touched no `service-analytics` file), via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (fix committed, each anchor 1 → 0, restore blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - C1 `--delete` the preview's door call: `3 failed | 24 passed` (the three refusals).
  - C2 one word of the copied message changed (`NOT run` → `not run`): `3 failed | 24 passed` (the field-by-field comparison with the live faces).
  - C3 a bucketed key's path spelled `groupBy.N` instead of `groupBy.N.field`: `3 failed | 24 passed`.
  - C4 the door refusing any second key, whatever its column: `3 failed | 24 passed` (region + month served, #28744 beside a month bucket, and the later-position refusal); so the still-served pins bite.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run` at `3b296a59`: `Test Files 203 passed (203)`, `Tests 4866 passed | 282 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics` at `722fbe7c` after a full build: `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 298 passed | 22 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` at `722fbe7c` exit 0; `eslint` on the four touched source and test files exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Consumers of the preview: the Studio paths that pass `previewDrafts` (`ui/packages/app-shell` dataset and chart previews) already receive the preview's other 400 refusals (#28555 and earlier); this adds one more selection to that set, never one a published query serves.
- Two buckets of one column (month and year) are refused too: it is the same engine refusal on the live faces, measured, and the card's root (one column, two values, one name).
- The preview's refusal runs after every other preview gate, so a selection refused for another reason keeps that refusal.
